decision: Owner-approved risk acceptance for the read-only furniture demo service
rationale: No Debian 13 (trixie) fixed version exists for these CVEs. The service runs non-root with dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges and no mount, nsenter, systemd-homed, infocmp or Archive::Tar use. Any other HIGH/CRITICAL finding still fails the gate.
review: Rebuild and remove entries as soon as Debian ships fixes; the gate fails after expires_on.
